name: PLaMo API (Preferred Networks)
description: Preferred Networks' Japanese flagship models with a free API plan.
overview: PLaMo is Preferred Networks' scratch-built Japanese foundation model family, served from api.platform.preferredai.jp with an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. PLaMo API has a Free plan that needs no card — PLaMo Chat runs on the same account — and plamo-3.0-fin-beta, the financial trial model, carries no token charge on any plan but is capped at 50 requests per 24 hours. The Free plan reserves prompts and completions for training; the paid Standard and Provider plans do not.

privacy.label: Free plan trains on your prompts

free_access: Free plan on PLaMo API and Chat
plamo-3.0-fin-beta is untokenised on every plan
notes: The Free plan's caps are unpublished and only visible in the console; it trains on what you send.
